source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: When somebody replies in MeetAlfred, where in Hubspot can I see the status update?

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: The Lead Status will be displayed as replied.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that a MeetAlfred reply causes the HubSpot Lead Status to display as replied.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: If they accept the connect request on LinkedIn, the Lead status will change to connected.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that accepting a LinkedIn connection request changes the HubSpot Lead Status to connected.
